description: Robotics engineering suite for Claude Code: /armature:init scaffolds a standardized project, then six interactive stage skills (pitch, spec, plan, derive, CAD, teacher), three agents (red-team, inventor, librarian), a wayfinding overlay for multi-session efforts, test-first authoring for robot software, a bench-debugging loop for hardware/firmware faults, and executable bench procedures for bring-up and verification run the pipeline the way a real engineering team would — budgets, traceability, datasheet provenance, and adversarial review included.
